name: roman_numeral
description: Convert small positive integers to Roman numerals; matched control copies Arabic integer in the same context.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
def roman(n):
 out=''
 for v,s in [(100,'C'),(90,'XC'),(50,'L'),(40,'XL'),(10,'X'),(9,'IX'),(5,'V'),(4,'IV'),(1,'I')]:
  while n>=v: out+=s;n-=v
 return out
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 n=random.randint(1,99)
 context=random.choice(['Convert the number','Write the integer','Represent the value'])
 items.append({'prompt':f'{context} {n} in Roman numerals. Answer:', 'answer':' '+roman(n)})
 control.append({'prompt':f'{context} {n} in Arabic numerals. Answer:', 'answer':' '+str(n)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
